description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeader class, which represents a specific implementation of the MetadataHeader interface. It manages key-value pairs for metadata headers, providing methods for creation, comparison, serialization to JSON, and extracting instances from JSON objects.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeader
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetadataHeader, encapsulating a header key and value, providing JSON serialization, comparison, and extraction from JSON objects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultMetadataHeader with specified key and value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeader instance from a given JSON object, extracting key and value.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the metadata header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the metadata header.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this header with another for ordering based on key and value.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the header to a JSON object.
